messages:
maya: Starting v2 slowstart rollout for EU cluster. Rolling out proxy + header-normalize change at 5% for 30m.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary at 5% -> 5 hosts, window 30m.

alex: I'll update release notes; call out header-case normalization and that clients should tolerate casefolding.

jordan: SRE checks: auto-rollback triggers set: 5xx_rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increase > 300ms.

liam: ops note: can we exclude a handful of legacy tenants?

maya: yes, let's pin legacy-co and tenant-12345 to v1 for this rollout.

alex: how do I add pins?

liam: run:
```
deploybot pin add --tenant legacy-co --reason "legacy client schema" --until 2026-04-01
```

alex: running now.

deploy-bot: pin added by alex for tenant legacy-co.

deploy-bot: canary start confirmed at 05:12UTC.

jordan: telemetry: small uptick in 429s from mobile proxy in EU-A at 05:18UTC, rate ~0.6% but trending.

maya: hold on additional ramp until we confirm. pausing slowstart ramp.

alex: updated release notes with a short note and a link to the SDK compatibility doc.

natasha: product ops will notify top 10 customers in EU about temporary header behavior.

liam: I toggled header-normalize off in the proxy for EU-A (flag: header_normalize=false) to stop 429s.

deploy-bot: traffic rebalanced: flagged hosts moved to v1 for affected tenants.

jordan: after toggling, 429 rate dropped back to baseline in 3m. p95 latency stable.

maya: good, let's keep canary at 5% but disable header normalization while we patch the mobile SDK. set manual rollback threshold lower: revert to 0% immediately on 5xx_rate > 0.8% for next 2 hours.

alex: will add note to changelog: temporary toggle off, re-enable after SDK patch.

natasha: sending customer heads-up now.

maya: action items: 1) SRE to monitor rolling window alerts (jordan) 2) Mobile eng to patch SDK and verify (assign to mobile team) 3) Ops to keep pinlist until confirmed (liam) 4) Release notes and comms (alex/natasha).

jordan: will create a short dashboard + alert link: query: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~\"5..\",route=\"/v2\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{route=\"/v2\"}[5m]))` > 0.008 -> pager.

maya: thanks everyone. Reopen thread with re-deploy plan after mobile SDK patch. :white_check_mark:
